observations: Inspected all14 final master-left/viewing-right lossless PNG native1:1 pairs: record placement, table-supported cup/cloth, keyboard cross/hand contact, guitar picking/fretting, corrected bass plucking, drum/snare contact, mounted-mic mouth/eyes, joyful summer, closed recognition, first plea eyes/tears, final tearful face and supported hand/cup.

Viewing mildly smooths hair, lace/cloth and dark backdrop texture. Critical facial expressions, eye direction, mouth/teeth contours, tear highlights/tracks, silver cross, connected hand silhouettes and instrument/cup contacts remain legible. No blocking new block boundary, ring/pendant loss or expression reset is identified in these sampled stills.

Final tear tracks and wet-eye detail remain visible through the actual last frame6666, with the same vulnerable parted mouth and ambiguity as the accepted master; compression does not turn the look into a smile or erase the tears.

Native896x512 source softness and intentional tighter B06 framing remain source limitations. This comparison checks compression; it does not repair or freshly approve anatomy, exact notes, phonemes or every-frame temporal quality.

The first bass ROI sampled lower wardrobe rather than contact; actual full-frame inspection located the plucking hand and a fresh corrected-v2 pair was prepared. Initial index/PNG remain preserved and are not the accepted bass evidence.
limits: Scoped native still compression review only, not universal artifact-free approval. Complete cadence/decode/audio-packet/SSIM and actual-browser checks are separate, followed by the additional independent full-viewing playback.
